fusions.name: Sand-Swimmer
fusions.desc: Burrows up to 5 tiles to the target and strikes for 12 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shade-Cold Subsoil
fusions.desc: Flings a spadeful of cold subsoil in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Buried Clutch
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to bury a clutch beside you that hatches at once. The hatchling fights for 12 seconds: every 1.5 seconds it strikes an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage.

fusions.name: Sun-Baked Clay
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.
